about: Lens profiles chosen by hand for cameras Gyroflow's database has none for, by lens type (lens_pick.rs). A camera's key is its brand and model as Gyroflow reads them, or as the file names itself where Gyroflow doesn't know the model (geotag::dji_model, gopro_model; gyroflow-probe --lens: camera). recorded: the lens mode the camera writes (DJI: StreamMeta.fov_type; HERO4: udta SETT, probe::recorded_lens_mode), or Gyroflow's name for it ('Wide') -> the type it is; a mode not here shows as 'Unknown (mode N)'. default: the type of a clip that neither was given one nor recorded one named here (a drone, which records no mode). types: in the order the Library offers them; profile: a key of Gyroflow's database (its file path under camera_presets), a lens profile file, {'focal_35mm': mm} or {'hfov': degrees} for a focal length alone (no distortion), or null when the camera's own lens in the file is what it takes; sizes: another profile per resolution ('3840x2880') or aspect ratio ('4:3'). A clip's own choice is source.lens_type in its .afp.json. The same shape in the app's data folder (curated_lenses.json, or $AFP_CURATED_LENSES) is laid over this one: README, 'Your own lens list'

types.label: Wide
types.note: Recorded as fov_type 1. With EIS off the camera writes its own lens and motion data in the file; with EIS on nothing yet

types.label: Normal
types.note: Recorded as fov_type 2. The original Osmo Action's standard lens (145°, f/2.8, by Silver): Anton's projects of the 2026-10-20 dive (0122-0135, EIS off, no motion data) use it and it works

types.label: Wide
types.note: udta SETT lens mode 0 (markers::hero4_lens_mode). Its lens comes from the player's own database for exactly the clip's size and frame rate (resources/lenses: 1080p 59.94, 2.7K 59.94, 4K 29.97, estimated from Anton's footage, lens_profiles#41), else none: no ready lens. Gyroflow's HERO4 Black profiles don't say their mode and have no readout. Before 2026-11-24 this type had Mike Petrichenko's 2.7K 59.94 profile, and SETT codes weren't named

types.label: Medium
types.note: udta SETT lens mode 2: 2.7K Medium is a 1:1 window of the 4K sensor (f about 1770 px). Its lens from the player's own database (2.7K at 23.98, 29.97, 59.94, estimated from Anton's footage), else none. Code 4 (Narrow?) isn't named: no clip of it was estimated

types.label: Main camera
types.note: The drone straightens its picture itself and the gimbal holds it, so a focal length is all the stabilization needs: 24 mm equivalent (82.1°, DJI's spec). Gyroflow's database has only a 720p screen profile of it. Gyroflow reads the camera as 'DJI' alone; geotag::dji_model names it from DJI's header

types.label: Main camera
types.note: Camera FC220 (udta/©mdl, geotag::dji_model; Gyroflow doesn't read these files). 26 mm equivalent (78.8°, DJI's spec), straightened in the drone. Gyroflow's database has a Mavic Pro 1 4K 29.97 profile, but it's voted down (1 good, 37 bad, 2026-11)

types.label: Main camera
types.note: Camera FC3170. 24 mm equivalent (84°, DJI's spec), straightened in the drone. Anton's clips were saved again by DJI's muxer (Lavf56) and say nothing; geotag::dji_model names them from the drone's photos beside them. Gyroflow's Mavic Air 2 4K profiles are voted down (4/88, 1/64, 2026-11)
